entries.claim: The pinned Latin Mass data independently corroborate the component's substantive Latin and expose accidental editorial variants for collation.

locator.section: Rubricae generales 115 a, conclusion addressed to the Father; literal list punctuation retained

entries.claim: This same-edition common passage supplies the full literal w034–w055 expansion of its Per Dóminum cue. RG 115 a applies to an oration addressed to the Father in Mass or Office; its unaccented word forms, tuum, qui and final list semicolon remain literal in mr, while canonical house typography is declared in apparatus. This is not an independent edition.

locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo Missae rubric and chant formula after the secrets

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.

The approved Benziger proper page prints the complete petition/body through w033 and its abbreviation control Per Dóminum. The full w034–w055 conclusion is supplied by the separately cited RG 115 a, not printed on this proper leaf.
